The '''Nibiru system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kakani sector/Legends|Kakani sector]] in the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nibiru]].
